title: TanStack Virtual
description: Render large lists efficiently with headless virtualization.

data.text: TanStack Virtual is a headless virtualization library for rendering large lists, tables, and grids efficiently. Instead of rendering thousands of DOM nodes, it only renders the items currently visible in the viewport, dramatically improving performance.

Virtualization reduces initial render time and memory usage. For example, a list with 10,000 items can be rendered with fewer than 50 actual DOM nodes. The library handles scroll events, item sizing, and dynamic content out of the box.
Common interview topics include the difference between fixed-size and dynamic-size virtualization, how overscan reduces flicker, and when to use virtualization versus infinite scroll.

data.title: Overscan
data.text: Overscan renders a few extra items above and below the visible viewport to reduce flicker during fast scrolling. A value of 3 to 5 is usually sufficient.

items.question: When should I use virtualization?
items.answer: When rendering more than a few hundred rows or when scroll performance becomes sluggish.

items.question: Can virtualized items have variable heights?
items.answer: Yes, TanStack Virtual supports dynamic measurement. Use estimateSize for initial guess and measureElement for accurate sizing.

items.question: Does virtualization work with tables?
items.answer: Yes. TanStack Virtual pairs with TanStack Table for row virtualization in data grids.

items.question: Is virtualization the same as infinite scroll?
items.answer: No. Virtualization recycles a fixed set of DOM nodes. Infinite scroll appends new nodes as the user scrolls.

items.question: What about SEO?
items.answer: Virtualization can hide content from crawlers. For critical SEO content, render server-side without virtualization.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Virtualization renders only visible items to improve performance.
Overscan prevents blank space during fast scrolling.
TanStack Virtual supports dynamic item heights out of the box.
Pair with TanStack Table for large data grids.
data.takeaway: TanStack Virtual is the modern choice for list virtualization in React.
